files.title: Clicks after leaving
files.expected: No activity once a student has unregistered.
files.found: 412 registrations show clicks after their unregistration date, 9,300 clicks in all.
files.decided: Kept the students; dropped clicks dated after leaving so they cannot leak the outcome.

files.title: Gone before day one
files.found: Some students unregistered before the module started.
files.decided: Removed from every analysis: they never began, so they are not withdrawals in any useful sense.

files.title: Withdrawn, but no date
files.expected: Every withdrawn student has an unregistration date.
files.found: Some withdrawn results have no date.
files.decided: Kept as withdrawals; excluded from the replay's timing only.

files.title: Grades from last time
files.found: Some results were carried over (banked) from an earlier attempt.

files.title: Deprivation band missing
files.found: Missing more often in some regions.
files.decided: Shown as its own 'Unknown' group in the fairness audit, not dropped.

files.title: Empty week fields
files.expected: Resource week fields are filled in.
files.decided: Not used; weeks are computed from click dates instead.

files.title: Duplicate registrations
files.expected: One row per student per module per term.

files.title: Orphan rows
files.expected: Every click and submission matches a registration.
